dashboard.label: Windows Authentication Investigation
dashboard.description: Network authentication comparisons from the SOC lab on 26 October 2026. Task authentication uses the earlier batch-logon experiment. Times are UTC.

search.query: index=lab_windows host IN (SOC-SRV01,SOC-DC01) Channel=Security TargetDomainName=SOC TargetUserName=lab.* EventCode IN (4624,4625) earliest="10/26/2026:15:38:40" latest="10/26/2026:23:06:00" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | search EventCode=4625 | timechart span=30m count AS failures

panel.title: Failures and successes by source and account

search.query: index=lab_windows host IN (SOC-SRV01,SOC-DC01) Channel=Security TargetDomainName=SOC TargetUserName=lab.* EventCode IN (4624,4625) earliest="10/26/2026:15:38:40" latest="10/26/2026:23:06:00" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | stats count(eval(EventCode=4625)) AS failures count(eval(EventCode=4624)) AS successes BY IpAddress TargetUserName

index=lab_windows host IN (SOC-SRV01,SOC-DC01) Channel=Security TargetDomainName=SOC TargetUserName=lab.* EventCode IN (4624,4625) earliest="10/26/2026:15:38:40" latest="10/26/2026:23:06:00" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | search EventCode=4625 | stats count AS records BY LogonType Status SubStatus

panel.title: Repeated account: three failures within five minutes

search.query: index=lab_windows host=SOC-SRV01 Channel=Security TargetDomainName=SOC TargetUserName=lab.repeat EventCode=4625 earliest="10/26/2026:18:39:00" latest="10/26/2026:23:00:00" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | sort 0 _time | streamstats time_window=5m count AS failures BY TargetDomainName TargetUserName IpAddress Computer | where failures>=3 | table _time TargetUserName IpAddress failures EventRecordID

panel.title: Five accounts from one source within ten minutes

search.query: index=lab_windows host=SOC-SRV01 Channel=Security EventCode=4625 TargetUserName IN (lab.user1,lab.user2,lab.user3,lab.user4,lab.user5) earliest="10/26/2026:18:38:05" latest="10/26/2026:18:48:05" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | stats dc(TargetUserName) AS accounts values(TargetUserName) AS users BY IpAddress | where accounts>=5

panel.title: Success after failure: account and time controls

search.query: index=lab_windows host=SOC-SRV01 Channel=Security EventCode IN (4624,4625) TargetUserName IN (lab.user1,lab.ops) earliest="10/26/2026:18:49:58" latest="10/26/2026:19:26:08" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | sort 0 _time | eval failed_at=if(EventCode=4625,_time,null()) | streamstats max(failed_at) AS last_failure BY TargetUserName IpAddress | where EventCode=4624 | eval seconds_since_failure=round(_time-last_failure), matched=if(seconds_since_failure<=300,"yes","no") | table _time TargetUserName IpAddress seconds_since_failure matched EventRecordID

panel.title: Lockout, administrative unlock and authentication recovery

search.query: index=lab_windows host=SOC-DC01 Channel=Security EventCode IN (4624,4625,4740,4767) TargetUserName=lab.lockout earliest="10/26/2026:22:00:00" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | sort 0 _time | table _time EventCode LogonType IpAddress Status SubStatus EventRecordID

index=lab_windows Channel=Security TargetUserName=lab.disabled earliest="10/26/2026:21:30:00" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | sort 0 _time | table _time host EventCode TargetUserName LogonType IpAddress Status SubStatus EventRecordID

index=lab_windows Channel=Security TargetUserName=lab.stale earliest="10/26/2026:11:15:00" latest="10/26/2026:11:49:00" | dedup Computer Channel EventRecordID | sort 0 _time | table _time host EventCode LogonType Status SubStatus EventRecordID
